channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Euro wavers within range against British Pound with markets calm and little data
item.description: The Euro (EUR) edges up for the second consecutive day against the British Pound (GBP) on Wednesday, trading halfway within the monthly range.

item.title: Hungarian Forint: MNB caution offers modest HUF support - Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose reports that Hungary’s central bank, Magyar Nemzeti Bank (MNB), cut its base rate to 5.50% but avoided pre-committing to further easing, stressing that September’s Inflation Report will guide policy. The bank will monitor global rate hikes, could limit the scope.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Dips below 0.5950, fresh weekly low as USD firms ahead of US PCE
item.description: The NZD/USD pair comes under some renewed selling pressure on Wednesday and drops to a fresh weekly low, around the 0.5945 region during the early European session.

item.title: Euro: Holds near 1.1670 against US Dollar as rate moves offset - Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team reports that EUR/USD remained little changed around 1.1670, with the chart showing only a modest pullback from overnight highs before a partial recovery.

item.title: ECB sets for September rate hike with no appetite to signal more – RTE
item.description: According to sources, the European Central Bank (ECB) is all set to hike its key policy rates at the September policy meeting, RTE reported. Sources also said that the central bank has no appetite to raise interest rates again after a hike next month.

item.title: British Pound edges lower below 1.3650 as traders await US PCE release
item.description: The GBP/USD pair declines to near 1.3625 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. The US Dollar (USD) edges higher against the British Pound (GBP) as markets turn cautious ahead of the US July Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index data, which is due later on Wednesday.

item.title: British Pound: Upside remains intact above 1.3605 against US Dollar - UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann maintain a positive 1–3 week outlook for GBP/USD, with 1.3700 still in sight as long as the pair holds above 1.3605.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: 20-day EMA continues to act as key barrier
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) trades higher against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, with USD/JPY dropping 0.1% to near 159.00. The Asia-Pacific currency gains amid firm expectations that the Bank of Japan (BoJ) will hike policy rates by 25 basis points (bps) to 1.25% in the September meeting.

item.title: Equities: Tech-led gains with softer Oil – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank notes that Nvidia’s earnings have become a major macro catalyst, although the impact of positive surprises has faded in recent quarters.

item.title: US Dollar: Core PCE and Warsh remarks in focus – OCBC
item.description: OCBC Bank strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong highlight that lower energy prices have helped pull US and European yields down, supporting a more benign macro backdrop without stoking USD debasement fears.

item.title: Australian Dollar: RBA waits as inflation sticks – Commerzbank
item.description: Volkmar Baur at Commerzbank notes that the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) is in wait-and-see mode after three rate hikes, assessing how inflation and the labor market evolve. July Consumer Price Index (CPI) eased to 3.5% but missed expectations, with trimmed-mean inflation stuck at 3.6%.

item.title: Gold remains depressed below $4,650 on firmer USD; looks to US PCE for Fed rate outlook
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) sticks to modest losses below $4,650 heading into the European session on Wednesday, though it lacks bearish conviction and remains confined within the previous day's broader range.

item.title: Canadian Dollar gives away gains amid lower oil prices, fresh trade tensions
item.description: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) reverses earlier gains against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, weighed by a recent pullback in oil prices and the escalation of the trade war with the US.

item.title: Oil: Prices retreat on Gulf diplomacy – ING
item.description: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Oil prices are under renewed downward pressure, with ICE Brent breaking below $90/bbl as talks involving Iran, Oman and Pakistan on the Strait of Hormuz and the Middle East war progress.

item.title: Euro weakens against Japanese Yen amid firm BoJ interest rate hike prospects
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades 0.22% lower at around 185.45 against the Japanese Yen (JPY) during the early European trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: Euro: Upside bias toward 1.1725 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann report EUR/USD broke out of its recent tight range, closing slightly higher near 1.1675 as tentative upside momentum emerges.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Hot Australian CPI data boosts hawkish RBA bets
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) outperforms its major currency peers on Wednesday, trading 0.2% higher to near 0.7180 against the US Dollar (USD) during the early European trading session.

item.title: ECB's Schnabel: Inflation likely to top 2% for extended period
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) Executive Board member Isabel Schnabel said that inflation is unlikely to return to target over the medium term, and therefore further tightening will be necessary, Bloomberg reported on Wednesday.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Declines to near 1.1650, overbought signals curb upside bias
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades in negative territory near 1.1665 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday, pressured by a rebound in the US Dollar (USD). Markets turn cautious ahead of the release of the key US July Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index report later on Wednesday.

item.title: Swiss Franc weakens as US Dollar gains ahead of PCE inflation data
item.description: USD/CHF gains ground after posting minor losses, trading around 0.8040 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) gains support ahead of the upcoming US Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) release, the Federal Reserve’s key inflation metric.

item.title: Asian stock markets gain as oil extends downfall, eyes on Jackson Hole Symposium
item.description: Asian stock markets reflect broader strength on Wednesday, as oil prices have fallen further on renewed hopes of the Strait of Hormuz, a vital passage for almost 20% of global energy supply, reopening.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Seems vulnerable below $80.00 as break below 50% Fibo. comes into play
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – remains under some selling pressure for the third straight day and drops to a nearly two-week low during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah remains subdued amid market caution, external headwinds
item.description: USD/IDR remains stronger for the second successive day, trading around 17,760 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair continues to hold its ground while the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) faces ongoing pressure from a cautious market sentiment and persistent external headwinds.

item.title: United States Dollar Index recovers to near 99.00 ahead of US PCE inflation data
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 99.00 in the early European trading hours on Wednesday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Japan’s Kiuchi: CPI expected to gradually rise due to Middle East conditions
item.description: Japan's Economy Minister Minoru Kiuchi said on Wednesday that he expects consumer prices to gradually rise amid the Middle East situation.

item.title: British Pound edges lower but remains close to multi-month top as USD awaits US PCE
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades with a negative bias below mid-1.3600s during the Asian session on Wednesday, eroding a part of the previous day's strong gains.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Remains sideways ahead of key US events
item.description: The Euro (EUR) continues to trade in a tight range at around 1.1660 against the US Dollar (USD) during the Asian trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD holds firmly above $69 ahead of US PCE Inflation data
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) is up almost 1% to near $69.40 during the Asian trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar declines as US Dollar advances ahead of PCE index data
item.description: NZD/USD depreciates after registering modest gains in the previous day, trading around 0.5960 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.
